summary: MediaBrowser.MediaEncoding is the ffmpeg/ffprobe seam: a pure ffprobe-JSON->MediaInfo normalizer (ProbeResultNormalizer, 1784 lines, the single richest and best-tested unit), a version/capability validator (EncoderValidator), and four subprocess-driven service impls (MediaEncoder 1425, SubtitleEncoder 1057, TranscodeManager 758, AttachmentExtractor 508). EncodingHelper.cs (7987 lines, 195 methods) is a SEPARATE Controller file whose CORE software-transcode arg building (GetVideoEncoder/GetAudioEncoder libx264+aac selection, GetMapArgs stream mapping, GetProgressiveVideoArguments, GetVideoQualityParam/GetVideoBitrateParam/GetAudioBitrateParam, GetNumberOfThreads, CanStreamCopyVideo/Audio direct-play decision, IsCopyCodec) is in scope while its huge HW-accel matrix / tonemap / HDR body is DEFERRED. The dominant PORT REALITY: EVERY EncodingHelper method is built around the un-ported `EncodingJobInfo`/`StreamState`/`EncodingOptions`/`BaseEncodingJobOptions` state structs + the `TranscodeReason` flags — none of these exist in hermit-model yet, and the hermit-traits module docs EXPLICITLY defer them to 'the hermit-core encoder implementation (Wave 6)'. So EncodingHelper is NOT trait-shaped; it is standalone command-string builders that need those state structs ported first as a prerequisite unit. The four service traits in hermit-traits are already the object-safe, domain-tree-free SUBSET (no BaseItem receiver — item_id: Uuid; Stream -> Vec<u8>; no CancellationToken); the C# impls carry a much larger surface (SetAvailable*, Supports*, ExtractVideoImagesOnIntervalAccelerated, GetPrimaryPlaylist*VobFiles, Dispose) that is NOT on the trait and is either implementation-internal or belongs to the deferred HW/Bluray paths. TWO hard external-library facts dominate feasibility: (1) SubtitleEncoder/SubtitleEditParser wrap `libse` (Nikse.SubtitleEdit.Core) — the entire SubRip/SSA/ASS parsing engine — which has NO pure-Rust equivalent; the SrtParserTests/SsaParserTests/AssParserTests oracle exercises that parser DIRECTLY, so a hand-port of the three text-subtitle formats (srt/ssa/ass -> Vec<SubtitleTrackEvent>) is required, and IS the parity target. (2) GetSubtitleFileCharacterSet wraps `UTF.Unknown` charset detection — maps to encoding_rs + chardetng/charset-normalizer; the SubtitleEncoderTests Greek windows-1253/iso-8859-7 round-trip cases are the oracle. ALL std::process/tokio::process spawning (13 hits in MediaEncoder, 6 in AttachmentExtractor, 2 each in SubtitleEncoder/TranscodeManager) MUST go behind a `Transcoder` trait (fake in tests) — that trait does NOT exist in hermit-traits yet and must be authored here (or added to hermit-traits). The parity oracle is overwhelmingly ProbeResultNormalizer (30 probing assertions over 15 JSON fixtures + GetFrameRate/IsNearSquarePixelSar/GetEstimatedAudioBitrate theories) and the subtitle parsers — those are pure, fixture-driven, and portable with NO ffmpeg present. EncodingHelper has ZERO unit tests in this project (its tests live in a separate Jellyfin.Controller test project, out of scope), so the core-arg-building unit ports WITHOUT an oracle here — flag that.

BUT EncodingJobInfo/StreamState/EncodingOptions/BaseEncodingJobOptions/TranscodeReason/EncoderPreset — the state structs EncodingHelper is built around — are NOT ported anywhere. portable_units.name: probing (ffprobe DTOs + FFProbeHelpers + ProbeResultNormalizer)
portable_units.note: THE highest-value, fully-portable, best-tested unit — ZERO ffmpeg needed (input is a deserialized JSON blob, output is hermit-model MediaInfo). Port the ffprobe serde DTOs, FFProbeHelpers (case-insensitive tag dict, GetDictionaryNumericValue/DateTime), then ProbeResultNormalizer.GetMediaInfo + its pure statics: GetFrameRate (rational '2997/125'->23.976, '0/0'->null), IsNearSquarePixelSar (SAR ratio within variance), GetEstimatedAudioBitrate (the codec/profile/channel bitrate table incl. DTS-HD MA lossless per-channel + truehd/flac scaling), GetAspectRatio, the missing-video-bitrate = container - sum(other-stream) estimation (#16248), the nanosecond-DURATION-tag trimming (TimeSpan 7-digit limit -> bytes*8/seconds), interlace/anamorphic/DV/rotation parsing, and the iTunes/WTV XML metadata fetchers (quick-xml). No dependency on any other unit here except hermit-model.

portable_units.name: encoder_validator (EncoderValidator + version/library maps)
portable_units.note: Port the PURE half fully (the oracle): GetFFmpegVersionInternal (regex `^ffmpeg version n?((?:[0-9]+\.?)+)` -> Version), ValidateVersionInternal (>= MinVersion 4.4, library-version cross-check via LibraryRegex), the _ffmpegMinimumLibraryVersions map (libavutil 56.70, libavcodec 58.134, ...) and MinVersion=4.4. Also EncodingUtils.GetInputArgument/NormalizePath (quote-escaping, concat: prefix, protocol handling) — pure string building, needed by MediaEncoder.GetInputArgument. The capability-PROBE methods (GetCodecs/GetHwaccels/GetFilters/CheckVaapiDevice/CheckVulkan/CheckVideoToolbox) spawn ffmpeg and parse output -> go behind the Transcoder trait; the HW-specific Check* (vaapi/vulkan/videotoolbox) are DEFERRED per scope. Depends on nothing but the Transcoder seam.

portable_units.name: subtitles (SubtitleEditParser hand-port + SubtitleEncoder)
portable_units.kind: hand-ported format parsers + charset detect + Transcoder-driven extract
portable_units.note: TWO sub-parts. (a) parser: hand-port SubRip(srt)/SubStationAlpha(ssa)/AdvancedSubStationAlpha(ass) parsing from `libse` — each turns text lines into Vec<SubtitleTrackEvent> (Number, StartTime.Ticks, EndTime.Ticks, Text). The extension->format dispatch (reflection in C#) becomes a match. Oracle: SrtParserTests(2)/AssParserTests(1)/SsaParserTests(3) + fixtures example.srt/example2.srt/example.ass/example.ssa. (b) encoder: SubtitleEncoder.GetReadableFile (extension/protocol -> SubtitleInfo: local .ass/.ssa/.srt stay File+format; Http external gets fetched to a local File), GetSubtitleStream (charset-detect non-UTF-8 -> transcode to UTF-8 via encoding_rs+chardetng; already-UTF-8 short-circuits to disk stream), ConvertSubtitles (parse -> re-serialize to vtt/srt/ass with time-shift/preserve-timestamps), GetSubtitleFileCharacterSet (UTF.Unknown -> chardetng), GetSubtitleFilePath + ExtractAllExtractableSubtitles (spawn ffmpeg to demux embedded text/PGS subs -> Transcoder trait). Depends on: hermit-model (SubtitleTrackEvent), the Transcoder seam, NEW charset deps. AsyncKeyedLock -> keyed tokio Mutex for extract dedupe (ConvertSubtitles concurrency oracle).

portable_units.name: encoder_services (MediaEncoder + AttachmentExtractor + TranscodeManager)
portable_units.kind: Transcoder-driven service impls of the 4 traits
portable_units.note: The trait impls. MediaEncoder: SetFFmpegPath (locate+validate binary via encoder_validator), GetMediaInfo (spawn ffprobe -> probing unit), GetInputArgument/GetTimeParameter (pure, via EncodingUtils), ExtractAudioImage/ExtractVideoImage/ConvertImage (spawn ffmpeg -> Transcoder). DROP from the port: SetAvailable*/Supports*/CanEncodeTo* (HW-capability cache, deferred), ExtractVideoImagesOnIntervalAccelerated (HW), GetPrimaryPlaylist*VobFiles/GenerateConcatConfig (Bluray, deferred), the EncodingJobInfo overloads (belong to core-arg unit). GetExtraArguments (User-Agent from RequiredHttpHeaders) is pure — port it (ProbeExternalSourcesTests oracle). AttachmentExtractor: GetAttachment(item_id,...)/ExtractAllAttachments -> spawn ffmpeg -attach demux -> Transcoder + AsyncKeyedLock dedupe. TranscodeManager: the job registry (HashMap of TranscodingJobHandle by path/session), ping/kill/timeout/on-begin/on-end; DEFER the StartFfMpeg(StreamState) + session ReportTranscodingProgress wiring to hermit-core. EncodingConfigurationStore ('encoding' key) + minimal EncodingOptions serde. Depends on: probing, encoder_validator, subtitles(for encoder ctor), Transcoder seam, hermit-common config.

portable_units.note: IN SCOPE but has NO oracle in this test project (EncodingHelper's tests live in the out-of-scope Jellyfin.Controller test project) — flag that at PORT. behavioral_constants_to_surface: GetEstimatedAudioBitrate table (aac/mp3/mp2 192k|320k, ac3/eac3 192k|640k, dts lossy 768k|1509k / DTS-HD MA channels*700k, opus 128k|256k, vorbis 160k|320k, wma 192k|384k, flac/alac channels*480k, truehd/mlp channels*700k) — these are ROUGH fallback estimates only used when ffprobe omits a stream bitrate; asserted verbatim by 24 oracle cases so they must match. EncoderValidator MinVersion = 4.4 and _ffmpegMinimumLibraryVersions (libavutil 56.70, libavcodec 58.134, libavformat 58.76, libavdevice 58.13, libavfilter 7.110, libswscale 5.9, libswresample 3.9) — ffmpeg compatibility floor; asserted by ValidateVersionInternalTest. Domain constants tied to ffmpeg ABI, NOT user settings — keep as named consts.
_minFFmpegMultiThreadedCli = 7.0 — the version gate above which multi-threaded CLI is used; behavioral, keep as a named const.
IsNearSquarePixelSar variance = 0.005 (IsClose default) — the tolerance deciding 'near-square' SAR; asserted by 13 cases. Candidate SETTING (anamorphic detection sensitivity) — ASK the user.
GetNumberOfThreads default thread selection — reads EncodingOptions.EncodingThreadCount (already a config field); keep configurable.
AudioSpatialFormat / DTS profile string matches ('HD MA', 'DTS:X', 'Dolby Atmos') — domain codec strings, not settings.

Nanosecond DURATION over-precision trim to 7 digits — dictated by .NET TimeSpan (Rust chrono/Duration has ns precision, so the trim may be unnecessary in Rust; verify the bytes*8/seconds result still matches 800000 for the fixture) — behavioral, not a setting.
needs_external_crate: encoding_rs (REQUIRED, new) — decode legacy code pages (windows-1253, iso-8859-7, UTF-16LE) to UTF-8 for SubtitleEncoder.GetSubtitleStream. The Greek round-trip oracle depends on it. Not yet a workspace dep.

chardetng OR charset-normalizer (REQUIRED, new) — replaces UTF.Unknown CharsetDetector for GetSubtitleFileCharacterSet auto-detection. chardetng is the lean, well-maintained choice (Firefox's detector). Not yet a workspace dep.
quick-xml (already a workspace dep) — for ProbeResultNormalizer.FetchFromItunesInfo (iTunes plist XML) + FetchWtvInfo (WTV metadata XML). Confirm it covers the plist reader shape.

regex (already a workspace dep) — EncoderValidator FfmpegVersionRegex/LibraryRegex/CodecRegex/FilterRegex + ProbeResultNormalizer PerformerRegex/DurationOverPrecisionRegex. All are simple, no lookaround -> `regex` (not fancy-regex) suffices.

serde_json (already a workspace dep) — ffprobe InternalMediaInfoResult deserialization. Note the C# uses a JsonBoolStringConverter (bool-as-string) — port a serde deserialize-with helper for the string-typed booleans/numbers ffprobe emits.

tokio (already a workspace dep) — async fs + the keyed Mutex replacing AsyncKeyedLock + process spawning (behind the Transcoder trait). tokio::process is the concrete Transcoder impl; tests use a fake.
reqwest (already a workspace dep) — SubtitleEncoder remote-subtitle fetch (Http protocol -> local file before parse) + is the concrete User-Agent-forwarding path.

chrono (already a workspace dep) — TimeSpan/DateTime.Ticks arithmetic (subtitle event ticks, PremiereDate, duration). 1 tick = 100ns; port a ticks<->Duration helper (likely already in hermit-util from earlier waves).
NO Rust port of `libse` exists — the SubRip/SSA/ASS parsers MUST be hand-ported (this is a build task, not a dependency). NO Rust port of `BDInfo` needed (Blu-ray deferred).
